method: Authenticated local frontend with real private Nexus storage,1440x900; no cache overrides/throttling. Single SPA opening of a real local Photos area, before enlargement. Encoded bytes from Chrome Network.loadingFinished; first response completion is network timing, visible check is an upper bound including automation.
limitations: One observed sample using a local development frontend and connected private Nexus services; not a production performance benchmark.
No cache reset or throttling. Chrome reported fromDiskCache=false for all three image responses. Browser energy saving was enabled.
First resource completion is network timing, not image paint timing. The visible-image checks are upper bounds including automation and observation delay.
Encoded byte counts are browser network transfer figures and differ from the immutable source binary length. No request URLs, headers, tokens or private record IDs are included.
